selection_history.reason: Highest combination of sample size (5,800 matches, 99.3% feature coverage), lowest implementation complexity (binary target, existing binary-outcome tooling directly reusable), full research independence from the exhausted 1X2 question, live compatibility, and calibration feasibility -- all per the criteria in Phase 4 Section 18, explicitly not chosen for perceived historical profitability. BTTS and AH deferred (BTTS needs new market-odds extraction code; AH needs a line-handling design). Tennis deliberately not defaulted to per Section 5.

selection_history.decision: BTTS best estimator = market_implied_poisson; next recommended = live-data preservation + BTTS/OU prospective paper wiring, then Football Asian Handicap Stage A
Next: Phase 1 evidence plumbing (approval), research Cycle V2-1 margin-removal calibration, then V2-2 tennis market engine
De-vig C (retain proportional); Tennis ATP gate B (validated, live source unsolved); next: live-source solution + WTA engine

probability_engine_principle: Each market records its BEST AVAILABLE PROBABILITY ESTIMATOR, not the best model that beats the market. Market consensus is a legitimate estimator. The probability engine does not need historical betting profitability to be useful; the betting decision engine separately judges price/value/risk. See research/btts_outcome_prediction/PROBABILITY_ENGINE_ARCHITECTURE.md.
